title: Use OptiSweep Robot Selection “Go to” to recover a stalled AGV (drop off at hospital)
summary: When an AGV is “not in a task” and needs quick recovery (example: a tipper goes down and the AGV will not leave), use the OptiSweep Robot Selection “Go to” function to send the AGV to a selected square (hospital in the example). After the recovery action, the AGV should pick up a new task once the tote has been removed.
when_to_use: Use this when an AGV is not leaving / not executing a task and is described as “not in a task” in the OptiSweep Robot Selection view, including the example scenario where a tipper goes down.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the OptiSweep Robot Selection “Go to” recovery sequence (select AGV → Go to → select square → Confirm) and verify the AGV behavior after tote removal.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep Robot Selection view (Robot Selection screen)
Robot Selection controls/buttons: “Go to”, square/cell selection, “Confirm”

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep Robot Selection view (HMI)
system_preconditions: The target AGV is available in Robot Selection and is in a state described as “not in a task” for recovery.

visual_references.description: Robot Selection “Go-to function” slide frame showing the step sequence: Select an AGV → Select Go to → Select which square → Select Confirm.
Robot Selection “Go-to function” slide frame with additional UI context (selecting a cell/symbol shows rack information).

steps.title: Select the AGV that is “not in a task” and needs recovery
steps.purpose: Identify the correct AGV object in the Robot Selection view so the “Go to” command targets the intended vehicle.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep Robot Selection view, select the AGV that is described as “not in a task” and needs recovery (example use case: tipper down; AGV will not leave).
steps.expected_result: The intended AGV is selected in Robot Selection (so subsequent “Go to” applies to that AGV).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected AGV is the one you intend to recover (selection is on the correct AGV object in the Robot Selection view).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confidently identify/select the correct AGV object for recovery, or the selection does not correspond to the AGV that is stalled.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/nearby text includes: “Robot Selection Go-to function… An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square… 1. Select an AGV 2. Select Go to 3. Select which square you want the AGV to go to 4. Select Confirm.”
Transcript near this frame: “So you have to select the… object selection. You select the object… If you’re under AGV… you select this cell… it’ll show you the AGV information.”

steps.title: Select the “Go to” function for the selected AGV
steps.purpose: Initiate the recovery routing action for the selected AGV.
steps.instruction: With the AGV selected in the OptiSweep Robot Selection view, select the “Go to” function.
steps.expected_result: The “Go to” function is engaged for the selected AGV, enabling square selection.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI proceeds to the step where you can choose a target square/cell for the AGV.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting “Go to” does not enable square selection or does not appear to apply to the selected AGV.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/nearby text includes the step: “2. Select Go to”.

steps.title: Select the destination square (hospital in the example)
steps.purpose: Choose where the AGV should be sent to recover quickly; the example destination is the hospital.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep Robot Selection view, select which square you want the AGV to go to (example described: drop it off at the hospital).
steps.expected_result: A destination square/cell is selected as the target for the AGV “Go to” action.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected destination corresponds to the intended square (hospital in the example scenario).
steps.failure_condition: You select the wrong square/cell or cannot select a valid destination square for the AGV.

actions.label: Select square/cell
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/nearby text includes: “Select which square you want the AGV to go to” and the example: “use the go to function to drop it off at the hospital.”
OCR/nearby text around this frame reiterates: “An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square… drop it off at the hospital…”.

steps.title: Select “Confirm” to send the AGV to the chosen square
steps.purpose: Execute the “Go to” command after the destination square is selected.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep Robot Selection view, select “Confirm” to send the selected AGV to the chosen square.
steps.expected_result: The AGV is sent to the selected square (hospital in the example).
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV begins the recovery movement consistent with being routed to the chosen square.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not move to the selected square.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not move to the selected square, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/nearby text includes: “4. Select Confirm” and the recovery example: “drop it off at the hospital.”

steps.title: Verify the AGV picks up a new task after tote removal
steps.purpose: Complete the recovery loop by ensuring the AGV reinitializes and resumes work after the tote is removed.
steps.instruction: After the AGV has been sent to the hospital (example), remove the tote and then observe that the AGV picks up a new task once its tote has been removed.
steps.expected_result: The AGV picks up a new task after the tote is removed.
steps.healthy_condition: Post tote removal, the AGV transitions from the recovery state to executing a new task (task pickup behavior resumes).
steps.failure_condition: After tote removal, the AGV does not pick up a new task.

actions.label: Remove tote
actions.exact_action: Remove the tote (so the AGV’s tote is removed)

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV does not pick up a new task after tote removal, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript/OCR summary includes: “The AGV will pickup a new task once it’s tote has been removed.”
Transcript near this frame: “once you remove the tote from at the hospital… it drops and reinitialize and comes back and picks up a new tote.”

success_criteria: The selected AGV is sent to the chosen square (hospital in the example).
After tote removal, the AGV picks up a new task.
healthy_conditions: AGV recovery command results in movement to the selected square.
After tote removal, AGV task pickup resumes.
failure_conditions: AGV does not move to the selected square after Confirm.
AGV does not pick up a new task after tote removal.
escalation_guidance: If the AGV does not move to the selected square or does not pick up a new task after tote removal, stop and escalate for deeper troubleshooting (the source provides the recovery concept but not deeper troubleshooting steps).
